FLASHCARD SET · AGES 4–5

Healthy Food flashcards — the parent shelf: 21 cards to download and print.

The whole food-habit deck for printing at home: twenty-one healthy-eating cards for ages four to five, each with its parent tip, its three pills — age, subject, level — its download button and one-tap printing; the library is the parents’ side of the class, so everything happens on this one shelf.

This is the parents’ copy of Class 40 · Healthy Food & Eating Well: all twenty-one food-habit cards on one shelf, ready to print. You do not need a plan — pick the habit your table needs most, download the card, and print it full size on A4 or Letter paper. Every card carries its parent tip underneath and three pills on top: the age it suits, the shelf it belongs to, and the level to start at. The download button takes the full-size card; the print button runs a single card through your printer with nothing else on the page. There are no card pages to hop through: the shelf is the whole set.

The shelf is yours; the lesson is your child’s. The class page at Healthy Food & Eating Well teaches each habit the way a teacher would — spoken to your child, the habit in the child’s own words, one thing to try tonight — while this wall simply holds the deck for printing. Same twenty-one cards, two jobs: the lesson lives in the class, the library is where parents print.

THE THREE LEVELS

Name it, do it, own it.

Every card wears a level pill so tonight’s card takes one glance to choose. The levels are a suggested order, not a test — the habit your table needs most is always the right card.

  1. 01

    Level 1 · Name it

    the seven foods and food groups to name first — the plate, the rainbow and the shelf stars.

  2. 02

    Level 2 · Do it

    the nine meal-time routines — three meals, the snack, the water and the hands, then the sitting, the slowing and the chewing.

  3. 03

    Level 3 · Own it

    the five bigger habits — trying new foods, making the healthy choice, noticing full, eating together, feeling the energy.
